Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First paragraph.</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second paragraph.</span></div>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
